searchText: Hey <@689161464829050960>, <@243183686562873344>, <@830368514225340436> -- here is a PR I made to geth adding more information about the actual specification of `t8n` and `b11r`. Unfortunately, there are probably quite a few implementation-defined characteristics and I think it would take a while to document them all and then we'd need to always keep them in sync with the code. So I tried to do something in the middle ground. It would be great if as you implement it you could keep a list of things you run into that we can either i) change about the tools or ii) should be better specified. https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/26111 You didn't write an EIP? 💔 the problem is that t8n kinda keeps changing 😬 also note that withdrawals are not defined here - there are defined in my withdrawals PR i'll update the docs there once this is merged and i rebase pls ping me here if you have any trouble or questions while implementing

Hey <@689161464829050960>, <@243183686562873344>, <@830368514225340436> -- here is a PR I made to geth adding more information about the actual specification of `t8n` and `b11r`. Unfortunately, there are probably quite a few implementation-defined characteristics and I think it would take a while to document them all and then we'd need to always keep them in sync with the code. So I tried to do something in the middle ground. It would be great if as you implement it you could keep a list of things you run into that we can either i) change about the tools or ii) should be better specified.
https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/26111
